cases.why: the season's first rows read "No pick" again, as if the model skipped games it had not launched for (Stage 77 item 24).
a pre-launch row keeps the dash beside "Before launch".
every game without a pick says "Before launch", hiding a real missed save after launch.
the card note goes back to its own copy of the test, so the row and card can disagree.
cases.find: note = beforeLaunch(g) ? 'Before the first pick was saved.'
cases.replace: note = FIRST_SAVED && g.start && g.start < FIRST_SAVED ? 'Before the first pick was saved.'
